slug: 2024-05-01 Guinea-Bissau - Further Improvements in Tax Compliance (IMF technical assistance)

facts.fact: The IMF says the Kontaktu electronic filing and payment platform launched in 2021 and since March 2022 all large and medium taxpayers are required to file electronically.
The IMF says electronic tax payment options in Guinea-Bissau increased from zero to six since March 2022, with banks and telecoms offering them.
The IMF says electronic filing has been mandatory for all large and medium taxpayers since March 2022.
